propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 declare identical 1M context windows in MODEL_LADDER, making sonnet-to-opus escalation a zero-capacity-gain retry that wastes spend and produces false diagnostic conclusions about model adequacy.
Escalation rungs must be strictly increasing in declared window size; a rung offering no additional context must be skipped during context-limit retry to prevent guaranteed-failing paid calls.

New function escalation_rungs() filters models_at_or_above() to exclude rungs with windows not strictly greater than the last kept rung, consumed by both retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder).
models_at_or_above() and largest_window_tokens() remain unchanged; the fix is additive and does not affect model-class vocabulary resolution, provider stickiness, or size budget calculations.
